title: In Vitro Transcription of DNA Oligos by T7 Polymerase
author: Audrey Lapinaite
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ssqeedw
materials: Break gel slices with p-1000 tip.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 μl of RNase-free H2O to 70-80 mg of each NTP.
Adjust pH of each NTP to 6.8-7.2 by adding 5 µl of 5N NaOH followed by 10-90 µl of 1N NaOH, monitoring with pH stripes (6.5-10 range).

Measure absorbance of a 500-fold dilution (3 µl to 1.5 ml H2O) using the following λ max and ε max: ATP (259 nm, 1.59 × 10^4 cm-1 M-1), CTP (271 nm, 0.9 × 10^4 cm-1 M-1), GTP (253 nm, 1.37 × 10^4 cm-1 M-1), UTP (259 nm, 1.59 × 10^4 cm-1 M-1).
Calculate and dilute to reach a final concentration of 100 mM for each NTP.

steps.title: Prepare DNA Template
steps.instruction: Prepare the DNA oligo template for transcription.

substeps.instruction: Mix 20 µl 5x transcription buffer, 1.5 nmol T7oligo (15 uM final), 1.0 nmol template (10 uM final), and DEPC H2O to a final volume of 100 µl.
Heat at 70-80 °C for 2 minutes.
Use immediately or store at -20 °C.

steps.title: Perform In Vitro Transcription
steps.instruction: Execute the transcription reaction using T7 polymerase.

substeps.instruction: In a 100 μl reaction, mix 100 mM ATP, 100 mM CTP, 100 mM GTP, 100 mM UTP, 1M DTT, 1 mg/mL pyrophosphatase (Roche), and 1 mg/mL T7 polymerase.
Incubate at 37 °C overnight.

steps.title: Optional DNase Treatment
steps.instruction: Remove the DNA template if required.

substeps.instruction: Add 5 units (5 μl) RNase-free DNase (Promega) directly to the reaction.
Incubate at 37 °C for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare Denaturing PAGE Gel
steps.instruction: Cast a 15% urea-polyacrylamide gel for RNA purification.

substeps.instruction: Clean glass plates with EtOH and coat with 200 μl Silanization Solution I.
Assemble glass plates.
Prepare 15% urea polyacrylamide gel using 40% Acrylamide-bisacrylamide (19:1), Urea, Water, and 10% APS/TEMED.
Pour the gel immediately after adding APS and TEMED.
Place comb and polymerize for 60 min.

steps.title: Run Electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Separate the transcribed RNA via gel electrophoresis.

substeps.instruction: Assemble electrophoresis apparatus and remove the comb.
Fill inner and outer buffer chambers with 1x TBE.
Rinse wells with 1x TBE buffer.
Pre-run the gel for 30 min at P=40 W, 3000 V, 400 mA to heat and remove urea.
Add 100 μl gel loading buffer (containing only bromophenol blue) to the 100 μl transcription reaction.
Load sample and run at P=40 W, 3000 V, 400 mA for approximately 3 h until the bromophenol blue band is in the last 1/4 of the gel.

steps.title: Excise and Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Recover the RNA from the polyacrylamide gel.

substeps.instruction: Remove one glass plate, cover with saran wrap, flip, and remove the second plate, covering again with saran wrap.
UV shadow the band, excise with a sterile razor, and place in a Falcon tube.
Crush and soak gel slices in an equal volume of RNase-free water.
Elute RNA overnight by rocking at 4 °C.
Filter gel pieces by spinning through a Corning Spin-X filter tube at top speed for 5 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Optional 5' Dephosphorylation
steps.instruction: Remove the 5' triphosphate if required for subsequent labeling.

substeps.instruction: Add 30 μl 10x NEBuffer 3 and 1 μl CIP (10 U/μl) to the sample.
Incubate at 37 °C for one hour.

steps.title: RNA Purification and Recovery
steps.instruction: Purify the RNA via extraction and precipitation.

substeps.instruction: Perform phenol/chloroform extraction using 300-500 μl phenol-chloroform solution (pH 8.0).
Precipitate RNA by adding 1/10 volume 3 M NaOAc (pH 5.2), 1/100 volume 100x linearized acrylamide, and 3 volumes 100% ethanol.
Incubate at -80 °C for at least 1 hour.
Centrifuge at top speed for 20 minutes at 4 °C.
Remove supernatant and wash the pellet with 70% ethanol.
Centrifuge again and remove supernatant.
Dry pellets in a speed vacuum for approximately 10 minutes.
Resuspend pellets in 30 μl DEPC H2O (or buffer) and store at -20 °C.
